2026

Location-Based Safety Management with Wearable Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Positioning

Anh-Van Vu, Seungwoo Chae, Changmin Sung, Van-Tuan Nguyen, Dongsoo Han

arXiv:2610.21503 · Preprint

A wearable–cloud positioning architecture that combines GNSS, inertial, and barometric measurements with map-aware fusion for continuous indoor–outdoor localization. The system supports geofencing and real-time monitoring for industrial safety under device power and communication constraints.

2025

A Black-Box Positioning Solution for Effortless Integration in Wearable Navigation

Anh-Van Vu, Changmin Sung, Dongsoo Han

2025 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC) · pp. 5762–5769

Presents PDRS, a self-contained inertial positioning module that performs real-time sensor fusion on an embedded processor and provides position estimates through I²C, SPI, and UART. Hardware–software co-design simplifies integration into low-power wearable and IoT platforms.

2024

Real-time Pedestrian Dead Reckoning For IoT Based Platform-Independent Positioning System

Anh-Van Vu, Thanh-Minh Nguyen, Changmin Sung, Dongsoo Han

2024 IEEE International Conference on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics (SMC) · pp. 2599–2606

An embedded pedestrian dead reckoning algorithm with acceleration-differential step detection and dynamic gyroscope bias updates. Processing inertial measurements directly on K-Tag reduces communication with the positioning server while supporting low-latency relative localization.

2022

An IoT Based Approach for Platform Independent Positioning Service

Anh-Van Vu, Dongsoo Han

2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Indoor Positioning and Indoor Navigation (IPIN) · pp. 1–8

Extends the KAILOS indoor positioning architecture with a dedicated IoT device to decouple sensing and localization from smartphone operating-system restrictions. The hardware and software design supports platform-independent access to indoor positioning services.

2020

Recommending the Workflow of Vietnamese Sign Language Translation via a Comparison of Several Classification Algorithms

Luyl-Da Quach, Nghia Duong-Trung, Anh-Van Vu, Chi-Ngon Nguyen

Computational Linguistics · PACLING 2019, Communications in Computer and Information Science, vol. 1215 · pp. 134–141

Evaluates classification methods within a Vietnamese Sign Language translation pipeline, focusing on the mapping from written Vietnamese to written sign-language sentences. The study informs model selection for preserving semantic content before visual gesture generation.

2018

Design of automatic irrigation system for greenhouse based on LoRa technology

Van Anh Vu, Dong Cong Trinh, Tuan Christian TRUVANT, Thanh Dang Bui

2018 International Conference on Advanced Technologies for Communications (ATC) · pp. 72–77

A LoRa-based wireless sensing and control network for greenhouse irrigation, integrating environmental data acquisition, remote monitoring, and automated irrigation control. The design connects distributed sensing with coordinated device communication for agricultural automation.
